hadith:
Tax (Zakat ul Fitr) - Narrated by Ibn 'Umar -  Volume 2, Book 25, Number 580 

Allah's Apostle made it incumbent on all the slave or free Muslims, male or female, to pay one Sa' of dates or barley as Zakat-ul-Fitr.
message: In the Name of Allah—the Most Beneficent, Most Merciful
name:
Al Muqtadir - الْمُقْتَدِرُ - The Creator of all power

The name signifies Allah's capability to execute His will and manage all affairs of creation. It emphasizes His strength and the fact that nothing occurs without His permission. Derived from the Arabic root 'q-d-r,' which relates to power and capability, Al Muqtadir is mentioned in the Quran, reflecting the attributes of strength and supreme authority.
verse:
Al-Mujadila - The Pleading Woman - 58:6

On the Day Allah resurrects them all together, He will then inform them of what they have done. Allah has kept account of it all, while they have forgotten it. For Allah is a Witness over all things.
